parole.testo: Inherited from Old Swedish dā hiorth, from dā (“fallow deer”) + hiorter (“deer”); dā is borrowed from Old English dā, from Proto-West Germanic *daihā, from Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁(y)-.
